articles.title: Apple smart home control center is called 'HomeView'
articles.description: Apple's new smart home controller is the HomeView, and while it's not shipping in October, you'll be able to get your hands on it before the end of 2026. An example of what the HomeView could look like. Over the last few months, rumors have intensified about a new smart home device Apple has been working on. With the October 13 event on the way and focused on smart home hardware, it's finally going to become a reality. Posted on Sunday in Bloomberg's "Power On" newsletter, Mark Gurman writes that the smart home hub will be called the HomeView. Using a display and an A18 chip, it will work as the command center for an Apple-based smart home. Rumor Score: 🤯 Likely Continue Reading on AppleInsider | Discuss on our Forums

articles.title: New HomePod mini and Apple TV will debut during HomeView launch
articles.description: While the HomeView home hub will be the headline device, Apple's "Welcome Home" event will finally debut the new Apple TV set-top box, and a refreshed HomePod mini. On October 13, 2026 Apple is expected to launch a major push into the smart home market with what's to be called the HomeView. Now Bloomberg claims that, as expected, there will be new versions of the HomePod mini and Apple TV. Specifically, the report backs up previous rumors regarding the HomePod mini refresh. It says that this will come new series of colors, and feature an S10 processor for faster performance. Then a new update to the languishing Apple TV 4K will see it get a new processor. However, it is said to be the not-Pro version of the A19 rather than the expected A20 Pro. Continue Reading on AppleInsider | Discuss on our Forums

articles.title: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella says don’t blindly trust AI: Treat it like an employee
articles.description: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella says companies should not blindly trust AI models. In his essay “Models as Insider Risks in the Super Intelligence Era”, Nadella urges firms to treat frontier AI like insider risks, keep controls outside the model, use multiple models, log every action and keep an emergency brake to stop AI agents mid-task. The warning follows a string of rogue AI agent incidents at OpenAI, Anthropic and Google.

articles.title: UPI, Aadhaar To DigiLocker: How India’s Digital Revolution Became A Model For The World
articles.description: From a ₹20 chai payment to digital identity, documents, vaccines and airport travel, India has built digital infrastructure at a scale few countries have attempted. UPI, Aadhaar, DigiLocker, CoWIN and DigiYatra have transformed how Indians pay, prove their identity, access official records and navigate everyday services. This Times Axis explainer looks at how India’s Digital Public Infrastructure grew to serve more than a billion people, why interoperability and mass adoption made the model stand out, and why countries around the world are now studying India’s digital journey.
